services.name: Fraud Scoring API
services.description: Real-time fraud probability scoring for financial transactions using ML models. Returns fraud score (0-1), decision (approve/review/decline), and contributing feature explanations.

services.name: Transaction Monitor API
services.description: Transaction velocity monitoring and anomaly detection API. Provides real-time velocity queries, alert management, and threshold configuration.

services.name: AML Engine API
services.description: Anti-money laundering pattern detection and regulatory reporting API. Manages AML rules, case creation, and FinCEN SAR/CTR filing.

services.name: Model Management API
services.description: ML model lifecycle management API. Handles model registration, version management, A/B test configuration, and performance monitoring.

endpoints.description: Score a transaction for fraud probability. Accepts transaction payload with amount, merchant, device, and geolocation data. Returns fraud score, decision, and feature contributions.
Retrieve a previously computed fraud score by transaction ID. Includes full feature breakdown and model version used.
Get detailed SHAP-based explanation of fraud score contributing factors for a specific transaction.
Query current transaction velocity for an account across all time windows (1min, 5min, 1hr, 24hr) and dimensions (account, merchant, device).
List transaction monitoring alerts with filtering by severity, status, time range, and dimension. Supports pagination.
Acknowledge a transaction monitoring alert. Stops escalation timer and assigns to the acknowledging analyst.
List AML cases with filtering by pattern type (structuring, layering, integration), status, confidence score, and date range.
Get detailed AML case including detection rule match, supporting transactions, and timeline of analyst actions.
Generate a pre-populated SAR form from AML case data. Returns SAR XML matching FinCEN schema for review before filing.
Submit SAR or CTR filing to FinCEN BSA E-Filing system. Supports single and batch submission. Returns filing confirmation numbers.
List registered fraud detection models with version history, performance metrics, and deployment status.
Deploy a model version to production. Supports traffic split configuration for A/B testing between model versions.
List active and completed A/B tests with per-variant metrics (AUC-ROC, false positive rate, latency) and statistical significance.
